HextaUI DateRangeCalendar interaction adapted from:
https://github.com/preetsuthar17/hextaui/blob/48accfd4200d5cc914156c38b0a858318228191f/components/ui/date-picker.tsx
Copyright (c) 2026 Preet Suthar, MIT. See HextaUI-LICENSE.txt.

The calendar uses react-day-picker 10.0.2 and date-fns. Their licenses are
included here. The bundle uses Antigravity's React instance and native
popover/menu controls. Rebuild with npm ci && npm run build:calendar.

The rest of HextaUI and its theme are not bundled.
